parts.text: (a) Sam walks for 30 minutes at 4 km/h and then runs 5 km in 25 minutes. Calculate his average speed. Give your answer in km/h. ............................................ km/h [3]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Tami walks for 10 minutes at x km/h and then runs y kilometres in z minutes. Find her average speed in terms of x , y and z . Give your answer in km/h, in its simplest form. ............................................ km/h [3]

content.tex: Tami walks for 10 minutes at \(x\) km/h and then runs \(y\) kilometres in \(z\) minutes.
Find her average speed in terms of \(x\) , \(y\) and \(z\) . Give your answer in km/h, in its simplest form.
